backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder for backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report file containing an empty features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose and functionality.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide outlining deployment steps, checks, and common build issues for the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining OKLCH color variables and theme styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component assembling header, sections, and footer into the page layout.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Interactive contact form with validation, simulated submission, and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section displaying mission text and three core values with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders a contact section with email, location, phone details, and a form, including phone sanitization for tel links.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with background image, headline text, CTAs, and smooth scrolling to other sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards driven by marketing copy, mapping icon names to Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with branding, navigation links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with large logo, scroll navigation, mobile menu, and CTA button.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports centralized logo asset paths for consistent branding.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Provides static marketing text for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context with login, identity loading, and status management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future query hooks using the actor; currently contains no active logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and light/dark theme CSS variables for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Provides Vite TypeScript environment type definitions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Vite’s Node environment with ESNext modules and bundler resolution.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite setup enabling React, path aliasing, build output settings, and a dev server on port 3000.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, including UI logo resizing and a blocked email routing feature request.
